Cystic malignancy of the ovary, a reproductive organ; no hormone disorder or qualifying extraovarian involvement is specified.
Tumour growth within uterine veins is defining vascular occupation; extension into the heart is not required for this label.
Primary tumour site is unknown and metastatic locations are unspecified; no particular organ axis can be assigned from this concept.
